name: Verify 'Опис' field of 'Що ми робимо' block stops at 300 characters by typing and pasting
description:
As an administrator of the Victory Center admin panel,
  I want to view, validate, and manage content in the "Хто ми" section,
  So that information across all blocks is accurate, validated, and safely published.

testStage.description:

  I want to view, validate, and manage content in the "Хто ми" section,
  So that information across all blocks is accurate, validated, and safely published.

steps.name: Given the administrator is logged in
And the admin navigates to the "Хто ми" page
Open Admin 'Хто ми' page
Wait until Admin 'Хто ми' page is loaded
When the admin selects the "Що ми робимо" tab
Select tab: Що ми робимо
Select category tab: Що ми робимо
Check if category tab 'Що ми робимо' is selected
Get selected category tab text
Check if category tab 'Що ми робимо' is selected
Get selected category tab text
When the admin clears the "Опис" field and types 299 characters
Clear description editor

Type text into description editor: AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA
Then the character counter reads "299/300"
Wait for character counter to equal '299/300'
Get character counter text
Get character counter text
And no validation message is displayed under the field
Wait for validation error message to disappear
Check if validation error message is displayed
Check if validation error message is displayed
Get validation error message
When the admin attempts to type an additional character into the "Опис" field
Type text into description editor: Z
Then the character counter reads "300/300"
Wait for character counter to equal '300/300'
Get character counter text
Get character counter text
And no validation message is displayed under the field
Wait for validation error message to disappear
Check if validation error message is displayed
Check if validation error message is displayed
Get validation error message
When the admin attempts to type an additional character into the "Опис" field
Type text into description editor: Z
Then the character counter remains "300/300"
Get character counter text
And the "Опис" field length does not exceed 300 characters
Get description text
When the admin clears the "Опис" field and pastes 301 characters
Clear description editor
Paste text into description editor
Get description text
Then the character counter remains "300/300"
Get character counter text
And the "Опис" field length does not exceed 300 characters
Get description text
